problem: सोइ रावन कहुँ बनी सहाई: बनी is feminine singular, so सहाई is the feminine noun सहायता (help, a combination of circumstances), not 'helpers' (masc. pl. would take बने). सोइ points back to the dohā: that very state (ministers flattering out of fear or hope) had come about for Rāvaṇa. The praisers of the second half are the ministers, implied by करहिं.
fix: रावणके लिये भी ठीक यही योग आ बना था: उसके मन्त्री उसे सुना-सुनाकर उसका गुणगान करते हैं। अवसर जानकर विभीषण आये और उन्होंने भाईके चरणोंमें सिर नवाया।

problem: Same as Hindi: बनी सहाई (feminine singular) means 'that very situation had come about', not 'he had found just such helpers'.
fix: That very state of things had come about for Rāvaṇa: his ministers praise him, making sure he hears it. Seeing his opportunity, Vibhīṣaṇa came and laid his head at the feet of his brother.

problem: Disagree with the writer's reading 'helpers': the feminine singular बनी agrees with सहाई as सहायता / संयोग, so the grammar favours the 'situation / combination' reading. Keep the doubt on file, but our reading should be the situation one.

problem: भवानी (addressed) is rendered हे भवानी!; the style sheet (§6) and every other batch render भवानी / गिरिजा as हे पार्वती.
fix: हे नाथ! कृपा करके मुझे अत्यन्त सुख देनेवाली, कभी न छूटनेवाली भक्ति दीजिये। हे पार्वती! हनुमान्‌जीकी परम सरल वाणी सुनकर तब प्रभुने कहा — ऐसा ही हो।

problem: 'Bhavānī' should be 'Pārvatī' (§6; the other batches use Pārvatī for भवानी). The first sentence also reverses the verse's order (अति सुखदायनी before अनपायनी).
fix: My Lord, be gracious and grant me devotion that gives the greatest joy and never fails. Hearing Hanumān's utterly guileless words, Pārvatī, the Lord then said: So be it.

problem: 'कमलनयनोंसे कृपापूर्वक निहारकर ... सेनाको देखा' says the same thing twice (निहारकर … देखा) and reverses the verse, which has 'saw the whole army' first and then 'looked on it with grace'.
fix: वे प्रभुके चरणकमलोंमें सिर झुकाते हैं; महाबली भालू और वानर गरजते हैं। श्रीरामजीने सारी वानर-सेनाको देखा और कृपा करके अपने कमल-जैसे नेत्रोंसे उसकी ओर निहारा।

problem: संभु अज: the style table gives शिवजी and ब्रह्माजी; 'शम्भु और ब्रह्मा' does not follow it. Mandodarī's own tone is unaffected: she uses honorifics for the gods throughout.
fix: आपके कुलरूपी कमलवनको कष्ट देनेवाली सीता जाड़ेकी रात-जैसी आयी है। सुनिये नाथ! सीताको लौटाये बिना शिवजी और ब्रह्माजी भी आपका हित नहीं कर सकते।
To the lotus-forest of your race Sītā has come like a winter night, bringing it grief. Listen, my lord: unless you give Sītā back, not even Śiva and Brahmā can do you any good.

problem: 'one at whose terror the guardians of the worlds tremble' is not idiomatic English.
fix: If the monkey army comes, the poor demons will have something to eat and live on. That the wife of one in terror of whom the guardians of the worlds tremble should be afraid is a great joke.

problem: उचित मत = proper / fitting counsel; 'ठीक-ठीक सलाह' means 'exact advice'.
fix: वह सभामें बैठा ही था कि खबर आयी — समुद्रके परले तटपर पूरी सेना आ पहुँची है। मन्त्रियोंसे उसने पूछा — उचित सलाह दो। सब हँस पड़े — आप चुप रहिये।

problem: The ministers flatter their king with a respectful plural (मष्ट करि रहहू; the Hindi has आप … रहिये), but 'Just keep quiet' sounds curt and dismissive, which is the wrong tone for flatterers.
fix: As he sat in the assembly, news reached him that the whole army had come to the far shore of the ocean. He asked his ministers: Tell me what course is right. They all laughed: Simply stay silent and at ease.
